checks.reason: Persistent revenue growth accompanied by strictly positive reported operating income. Break-even does not qualify. This overlaps with Sustained revenue growth.

checks.title: Cash-backed earnings

checks.reason: Positive profits, earnings-to-cash conversion and positive free cash flow across two separate years. Working capital, stock compensation and other non-cash items still require review.
